No, this card's security effect affects all of your opponent's Digimon, including Digimon that enter the battle area after the effect is activated.

Card Q&A.q: After my opponent activates this card's security effect, they use [BT1-089 Mimi Tachikawa] to move a Digimon from their breeding area to their battle area. Can that Digimon attack me immediately?

Effect: [Main] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase) and "This Digimon can't have its DP reduced or be returned to its owner's hand or deck" until the end of your opponent's next turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Your opponent's Digimon can't attack players for the turn.
